run_Predictor_predict: run the Predictor to generate pseudo-masks on an input image using MaskCut with DINO backbone
run_maskcut_function: run the maskcut function to extract bipartitions from an image using a DINO ViT backbone
run_densecrf_postprocess: run densecrf to post-process a bipartition mask and refine segmentation boundaries
run_vis_mask_overlay: run vis_mask to overlay a colored pseudo-mask onto an input image array
run_Predictor_setup: run Predictor setup to load DINO ViT base and small pretrained models onto GPU
